masked_cell_test.model: 2-component unweighted ridge ALS, lambda 0.02, 100 alternating steps, one fixed initialization per fold; no tuning
masked_cell_test.baseline: mean of observed training rows in the same disease column
masked_cell_test.warning: same 72 observed source estimates reused; repeated folds correlated; this is a missing-cell reconstruction diagnostic, not independent-cohort replication or risk prediction
